seo.title: Eternal Repos — Purpose-Built Ceremonial Mobility
seo.description: Standing beside families through the last goodbye — a dignified farewell for the one you've lost, and gentle support for those left behind.

hero.philosophy: Not just a final goodbye, but a sacred promise: to honor every memory with grace, care, and love.

slides.desc: From the first call to the final rites, we stay beside your family — arranging all that a farewell asks for, gently and with dignity, so you can simply be with the one you've lost.
Purpose-built ceremonial mobility and respectful coordination across Delhi NCR — giving your loved one the dignified, peaceful farewell they deserve.
From pure floral tributes and serene prayer halls to sacred Asthi Visarjan waters, our team guides you through every ritual with heartfelt warmth.
Our care does not end at the crematorium. We remain beside your family for grief support, paperwork assistance, and lasting remembrance.

lifeCircle.heading: Dignity for the one who's gone. Care for the ones still here.
lifeCircle.subcopy: From a single thread, our care blooms two ways — a farewell for the one you've lost, and a steady hand for the family that remains.
lifeCircle.bloomAriaLabel: Two blooms of care growing from one thread
lifeCircle.closingQuote: You grieve. We'll carry the rest.

quality.heading: How we care differently
quality.subcopy: Honest, dignified care with complete transparency — so your family never has to face confusion or unorganised arrangements.

tagore.quote: Death is not extinguishing the light; it is only putting out the lamp because the dawn has come.

remembrance.quote: The ones we love do not leave us — they become the light we carry.

closing.quote: When words fail, we stay beside you.

firstDay.subcopy: The shape of the day a family dreads — held, hour by hour, so they never face any of it alone.

vehicle.eyebrow: How we carry your loved one
vehicle.headingLead: The vehicle is the most visible part of our care —
vehicle.body: It carries the one you've lost with privacy and calm. But the real work is everything around it — the hands, the arrangements, the people who stay. The vehicle is simply where that care becomes something you can see.
vehicle.previewCaption: A quiet, private space — soft light, room to travel alongside.

partners.heading: In active partnership with hospitals — meeting families where the need begins.
partners.body: We work in direct partnership with hospitals, hospices, and care facilities across Delhi NCR — stepping in with dignity right at the ward door so doctors and nurses can focus on healing, while families receive immediate, compassionate care.

items.title: In Partnership with Hospitals & Hospices
items.desc: We are in official partnership with leading hospitals across Delhi NCR. When a patient passes away, our empanelled team takes over at the ward door — handling all post-life transfers, mortuary coordination, documentation assistance, and compassionate family guidance so medical teams can stay focused on clinical care.
lifts: Hospital death slip & clearance documentation guidance
Zero logistics burden on hospital doctors & nursing staff
Compassionate, respectful bedside handholding for families

items.title: Care & retirement homes
items.desc: A familiar, gentle presence for residents' final journey — handled with the tenderness of people you've trusted with your families for years, and with respect for the relationships you've built.
lifts: Continuity of the care you gave

items.title: Faith institutions & communities
items.desc: We honour the rites of every tradition — coordinating with priests, temples, mosques, churches and gurudwaras so the farewell follows custom exactly, and nothing feels unfamiliar or rushed.

items.title: Civic bodies & trusts
items.desc: Dignified handling at scale — for communities, welfare programmes and the moments that ask for quiet public responsibility, delivered with the same respect we give every single family.

partners.networkDesc: Empanelled with leading hospital networks, critical care centres, and mortuaries across Delhi, Noida, and Gurugram for prompt bedside clearance, death slip documentation guidance, and dignified transfer.

community.bannerAlt: Mahaprayaan, a community initiative — a space for the conversations we don't know how to start.

testimonials.heading: Held, when it mattered most.
testimonials.subcopy: Reflections and stories of care from the hardest hours a family faces.

items.quote: When my father passed away late at night, we felt completely helpless. Eternal stepped in with such gentle care — never a transaction, only quiet reverence, standing beside us the whole way.
items.name: Arjun Sharma

items.quote: They took care of the hospital paperwork, the transport, the priest — so my mother and I could just sit together in peace. Having someone truly care during our hardest hour made all the difference.
items.name: Meera Rastogi

items.quote: In a moment of overwhelming grief, Eternal gave us a calm sanctuary and gentle guidance through every step. We felt genuine warmth exactly when we needed it most.
items.name: Dr. V. K. Malhotra

finalCta.heading: Standing Beside You in Your Time of Need.
finalCta.body: Whenever you're ready — for gentle guidance, immediate help, or quiet pre-planning — we're only a call away.
finalCta.supportLine: 24/7 Compassionate Support · Standing Beside Families Across India
